analysis.company_profile: Moss builds AI‑powered platforms that deliver extraction, classification, anomaly detection and recommendation capabilities to enterprise customers, focusing on end‑to‑end LLM/ML pipelines.

candidate_positioning: A senior AI engineer with proven LLM, RAG, evaluation, and production MLOps experience who can own and scale Moss’s extraction and anomaly‑detection pipelines.

team_needs.need: Own LLM/ML pipelines for extraction, classification, anomaly detection, recommendations
team_needs.evidence: Senior AI Engineer (Optum): built lab extraction agent (extraction), cross‑encoder retrieval (classification), Isolation Forest/Holt‑Winters anomaly detection, SLA breach prediction with GPT‑4 reasoning (recommendations)
team_needs.gap: No dedicated recommendation engine built; classification focused on retrieval rather than generic multi‑class tasks

team_needs.need: Define evaluation & monitoring (gold sets, automated tests, robustness checks, SLAs, cost/latency tracking)
team_needs.evidence: Senior AI Engineer (Optum): automated evaluation and observability pipelines for QA and summary agents, LLM evaluators, tracing, failure detection
team_needs.gap: No explicit cost/latency tracking or formal SLA definition documented

team_needs.evidence: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Viavi): production‑grade SLA breach prediction deployed with FastAPI, MLflow, GPT‑4 reasoning; LangGraph analytics system integrated with AARP plans
team_needs.gap: Collaboration with dedicated Platform/Data Eng groups not explicitly mentioned

team_needs.need: Hands‑on LLM app/agent experience (tool use/function calling, RAG, structured outputs, guardrails) in production
team_needs.evidence: Senior AI Engineer (Optum) & Senior ML Engineer (Viavi): LangGraph analytics system, RAG‑based Project Discovery Assistant, multi‑agent RFP automation platform
team_needs.gap: No explicit mention of function‑calling implementation or guardrails for LLM agents

team_needs.need: Strong Python + ML stack (scikit‑learn, XGBoost/LightGBM, PyTorch/TF) and solid experiment/evaluation skills
team_needs.evidence: All roles: extensive Python work, XGBoost, LightGBM, MLflow, experiment tracking; scikit‑learn implied through XGBoost usage
team_needs.gap: No explicit PyTorch or TensorFlow experience listed

project.name: Adaptive LLM Extraction & Anomaly Detection Platform
project.problem: Moss needs an end‑to‑end, production‑ready pipeline that extracts information, classifies content, detects anomalies, and generates actionable recommendations while providing rigorous monitoring and cost/latency controls.
project.approach: Orchestrate Claude/OpenAI LLMs with LangGraph using function‑calling for extraction and structured output; fine‑tune a PyTorch classifier for multi‑class labeling; deploy LightGBM models for real‑time anomaly detection; build a recommendation layer that combines rule‑based logic with LLM reasoning; implement a gold‑set based evaluation suite with automated tests, robustness checks, and SLA thresholds; instrument latency and cost metrics via Prometheus/Grafana; manage experiments and model registry with MLflow; containerize services and deploy on Kubernetes in close partnership with Platform/Data Engineering.

requirements_not_covered: recorded collaboration with dedicated Platform/Data Engineering teams
